name: Marriott Bonvoy Bountiful Travel Credit Card

localized_names.en: Marriott Bonvoy Bountiful Travel Credit Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. 'You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.'

categories.label: Grocery stores and dining at restaurants including takeout and eligible delivery (first $15,000 combined annually, then 2x)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points automatically transferred to Marriott Bonvoy account. Free Night Award (up to 50,000 points) after $15,000 in spend each calendar year. 1,000 bonus points per eligible stay at participating Marriott Bonvoy properties.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 85,000 Bonus Points after you spend $4,000 in purchases in your first 3 months from your account opening.

benefits.title: Automatic Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatically receive Gold Elite Status each calendar year as a cardmember.

benefits.title: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Receive 15 Elite Night Credits each calendar year.

benefits.title: Free Night Award every year
benefits.description: Free Night Award every calendar year after $15,000 in spend, valid for a one night hotel stay at a property with a redemption level of up to 50,000 points.

benefits.title: 1,000 Bonus Points per eligible stay
benefits.description: Earn 1,000 bonus points per eligible stay at participating Marriott Bonvoy properties.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Complimentary DashPass
benefits.description: 12 months of complimentary DashPass for DoorDash and Caviar when activated between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2027.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged or stolen checked or carry-on baggage.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Coverage for unreimbursed expenses up to $500 per covered traveler if travel is delayed more than 12 hours or requires an overnight stay.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: Complimentary Visa Signature Concierge Service 24 hours a day.
